name: read_scene
description: Read the active animation: size, fps, duration, segments, and every layer of a scene (default root) with its id, name, type, parent, in/out, visibility, lock and shape tree paths. Start here to get layer ids.

name: inspect_layer
description: Full raw Lottie JSON of one layer plus its bounds at 'frame' and the list of animated property paths.

name: list_scenes
description: List the root scene and every nested scene (precomp) with ids and layer counts.

name: create_scene
description: Create an empty nested scene (precomp). With add_to_root, also place it as a layer on top of the root scene.

name: set_background
description: Set the preview/export background colour of the active animation (null for transparent). Stored in the dotLottie manifest on export.

name: list_colors
description: List every unique colour used by fills, strokes, solids and text, with usage counts — useful for recolouring.

name: replace_color
description: Replace a colour everywhere (fills, strokes, keyframes, solids, text). 'tolerance' 0..1 also matches near colours.

name: set_scene_settings
description: Change the active animation's canvas size, frame rate, duration (in frames) or name. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

name: create_shape
description: Create a new shape layer (rect, ellipse, polygon, star or freeform path) on top of the scene, with optional fill and stroke. Returns the new layer id.

position.description: Centre in scene coordinates (defaults to the scene centre)

points.description: Star/polygon point count, or path vertices [[x,y],...] relative to position

path.description: Bezier {v, i, o, c} relative to position

fill.description: Fill colour; null for no fill (default #c4c4c4)

name: create_solid
description: Create a solid colour layer covering the scene (or a given size).

name: create_null
description: Create an invisible null layer, useful as a parent/controller for other layers.

name: duplicate_layer
description: Duplicate a layer (with its animation) directly above the original. Returns the new id.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: delete_layer
description: Delete a layer. Children parented to it are unparented.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: rename_layer
description: Rename a layer. State machine interactions match layers by name, so keep names unique.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: reorder_layer
description: Move a layer in the stacking order: give an index (0 = top) or 'to' front/back/up/down.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: set_parent
description: Parent a layer to another layer in the same scene (child follows the parent's transform), or unparent with parent=null.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: set_layer_visibility
description: Show or hide a layer.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: set_layer_lock
description: Lock or unlock a layer for canvas editing (editor-only flag, not exported).

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: set_layer_time
description: Set a layer's in/out points, start time offset (frames) and time stretch.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: set_blend_mode
description: Set a layer's blend mode.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: set_matte
description: Use one layer as a track matte for another (alpha, alpha_inverted, luma, luma_inverted). The matte layer is moved directly above the target and hidden from direct rendering.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

matte_layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: remove_matte
description: Remove a layer's track matte.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: precompose_layers
description: Move layers into a new nested scene (precomp) and replace them with one precomp layer. Returns the new scene id and layer id.

name: align_layers
description: Align layers' bounding boxes to the scene or to the selection's combined bounds.

name: distribute_layers
description: Evenly space the centres of 3+ layers horizontally or vertically, keeping the outermost ones in place.

name: paste_layers
description: Insert copies of layer JSON objects (e.g. from inspect_layer) on top of a scene, assigning fresh ids and optionally offsetting them. Parent/matte links inside the pasted set are preserved.

name: nudge_layers
description: Move layers by a scene-space delta (dx, dy) like dragging on the canvas: static positions shift; animated positions get a keyframe at 'frame'. Parented layers are handled.

name: set_transform
description: Set transform properties of a layer (or a shape group via 'shape'). Static properties are replaced; animated ones get a keyframe at 'frame'. Rotation in degrees (clockwise), scale and opacity in percent.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

shape.description: Shape group path, e.g. '0'

name: set_anchor_point
description: Move a layer's anchor point to a named position of its bounds (center, top_left, …) or explicit layer-space [x,y], compensating position so the layer does not move visually.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: flip_layer
description: Mirror a layer horizontally or vertically by negating its scale.

layer.description: Layer id from read_scene (e.g. 'root:3') or a unique layer name

name: set_keyframe
description: Add or replace a keyframe on one property at an integer frame. A static property becomes animated. Optional easing (preset name, 'hold', or [x1,y1,x2,y2]) applies to the segment starting at this keyframe.

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

value.description: Number, [x,y], colour hex, or bezier {v,i,o,c} for paths

name: remove_keyframe
description: Remove the keyframe at a frame. When one keyframe or none remains the property becomes static.

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: move_keyframe
description: Move one keyframe from 'frame' to frame 'to' (fails if another keyframe is already there).

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: set_keyframe_easing
description: Set the easing of the segment that starts at the keyframe on 'frame'. Presets: linear, ease, ease_in, ease_out, ease_in_out, smooth, ease_in_back, ease_out_back, ease_in_out_back, snappy, hold — or a cubic bezier [x1,y1,x2,y2].

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: set_property
description: Set any property's value. Static properties are replaced; animated ones get a keyframe at 'frame' (default 0). Use this for shape items, masks ('mask:<i>') and effects ('effect:<i>') as well as transforms.

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: get_property
description: Read one property at a frame: evaluated value, whether it is animated, whether a keyframe sits on this frame, and all keyframe frames.

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: read_keyframes
description: List keyframes (frame, value, easing) of one property, or of every animated property of a layer when 'property' is omitted.

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: clear_animation
description: Remove all keyframes of a property, keeping its value at 'frame' (default the first keyframe) as a static value.

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: shift_keyframes
description: Move keyframes in time by 'by' frames (negative = earlier). Applies to one property, or all animated properties of the layer; optionally only keyframes at or after 'from_frame'.

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: retime_keyframes
description: Scale keyframe timing around a pivot frame (scale 2 = twice as slow, 0.5 = twice as fast).

shape.description: Optional shape path ('0', '0/1'), 'mask:<i>' or 'effect:<i>'

property.description: position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, skew, skew_axis, color, width, size, roundness, start, end, offset, path, … or a raw Lottie key

path.description: Alternative to shape+property: raw JSON path inside the layer as returned by read_keyframes (e.g. 'ks/p', 'shapes/1/c')

name: copy_animation
description: Copy a layer's transform animation (all animated transform properties, or the listed ones) onto another layer, optionally offset in time.

name: add_shape
description: Add a shape (rect, ellipse, polygon, star, path) as a new group inside an existing shape layer, on top of its other shapes. 'shape' may name a group to add into. Position is in layer space.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

position.description: Centre in scene coordinates (defaults to the scene centre)

points.description: Star/polygon point count, or path vertices [[x,y],...] relative to position

path.description: Bezier {v, i, o, c} relative to position

fill.description: Fill colour; null for no fill (default #c4c4c4)

name: remove_shape_item
description: Delete a shape item (geometry, paint, modifier or whole group) from a shape layer.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: set_path
description: Replace a path shape's bezier {v:[[x,y]...], i, o, c} (tangents relative to vertices). Animated paths get a keyframe at 'frame'.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: add_trim_path
description: Add a trim-paths modifier (start/end in %, offset in degrees) affecting all paths before it in the layer or group. Animate 'end' 0→100 for a draw-on effect.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: add_round_corners
description: Add a round-corners modifier with the given radius to the layer or group.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: add_repeater
description: Add a repeater that copies everything above it N times, each copy offset by position/rotation/scale, fading from start_opacity to end_opacity.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: update_shape_item
description: Update a shape item: animatable 'props' by friendly name (size, roundness, color, opacity, width, start, end, …) plus name, hidden, direction (1 or 3), fill_rule (non_zero|even_odd), line_cap (butt|round|square), line_join (miter|round|bevel), miter_limit, trim_mode (simultaneous|individual).

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: reorder_shape
description: Move a shape item to a new index within its parent list (0 = top).

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: set_fill
description: Set (or add) the solid fill of a shape layer or group: colour and opacity %. Animated colours get a keyframe at 'frame'.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: set_stroke
description: Set (or add) the stroke of a shape layer or group: colour, width, opacity, line_cap, line_join, dash [dash, gap].

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: set_gradient
description: Give a shape layer or group a linear or radial gradient fill/stroke. stops: [{offset 0..1, color, opacity 0..1?}]. start/end points in layer space default to the shape's bounds.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: remove_paint
description: Remove fills, strokes (solid or gradient) or both from a shape layer or group.

shape.description: Shape path, e.g. '0' or '0/2' (group children are nested)

name: add_mask
description: Add a mask to a layer: rect/ellipse (position + size in layer space, default the layer bounds) or a bezier path. Modes: add, subtract, intersect, lighten, darken, difference, none.

name: update_mask
description: Change a mask's mode, inversion, opacity, name or path (path keyframes via set_keyframe with shape 'mask:<i>').

name: remove_mask
description: Remove a mask from a layer.

name: add_effect
description: Add a layer effect: drop_shadow (color, opacity %, direction °, distance, softness, shadow_only), gaussian_blur (blurriness, dimensions both|horizontal|vertical), fill (color, opacity %), tint (black, white, amount %), tritone (highlights, midtones, shadows, blend %).

name: update_effect
description: Update parameters of a layer effect by index (see list_effects). Animated parameters get a keyframe at 'frame'; 'enabled' toggles the effect.

name: remove_effect
description: Remove a layer effect by index.

name: list_effects
description: List a layer's effects with their parameters.

name: create_text
description: Create a text layer. Position is the text anchor (baseline centre for centred text); give 'box' [w,h] for wrapped paragraph text.

name: set_text
description: Change a text layer's content (use \r or \n for line breaks).

name: set_text_style
description: Change font, size, colours, stroke, justification, tracking, line height or caps of a text layer.

name: list_slots
description: List slots (themeable properties) of the active animation with type, current value and how many properties are bound.

name: create_slot
description: Expose a property as a themeable slot (dotLottie themes override slots). Binds the property and records its current value as the slot default.

name: unlink_slot
description: Unbind a property from its slot (the slot is deleted when nothing else uses it).

name: update_slot_value
description: Change a slot's default value; every bound property updates.

name: list_themes
description: List project themes with their rule counts.

name: add_theme
description: Create a theme (a set of slot overrides exported to the dotLottie t/ folder).

name: update_theme_rule
description: Set (or with remove=true delete) a theme's override for one slot. Give 'value', or 'keyframes' [{frame, value}] for an animated override.

name: remove_theme
description: Delete a theme.

name: select_theme
description: Preview the animation with a theme applied (null for no theme).

name: list_segments
description: List named segments (markers) with start and end frames. State machine playback states play segments by name.

name: add_segment
description: Add a named segment (marker) from 'start' to 'end' frame.

name: update_segment
description: Rename or retime a segment.

name: remove_segment
description: Delete a segment.

name: list_state_machines
description: List the project's state machines.

name: add_state_machine
description: Create an empty state machine. Returns its id.

name: remove_state_machine
description: Delete a state machine.

name: rename_state_machine
description: Rename a state machine.

name: read_state_machine
description: Return a state machine as dotLottie spec JSON (initial, states, interactions, inputs).

name: add_state
description: Add a state: a playback state (plays the animation or a named segment with loop/mode/speed) or the single global state (type 'global') whose transitions are checked from any state. The first playback state becomes initial.

position.description: Node position in the graph editor

name: update_state
description: Change a state's settings (null removes an optional field). Renaming updates transitions, interactions and the initial state.

position.description: Node position in the graph editor

name: remove_state
description: Delete a state and every transition/interaction that refers to it.

name: set_initial_state
description: Choose the state the machine starts in.

name: add_transition
description: Add a transition from one state to another, optionally guarded by input conditions and tweened over a duration.

guards.description: [{input, condition: equal|not_equal|greater_than|greater_than_or_equal|less_than|less_than_or_equal, value (or "$otherInput")}] — all must pass; event inputs need only {input}

name: update_transition
description: Update the transition at 'index' in state 'from'.

guards.description: [{input, condition: equal|not_equal|greater_than|greater_than_or_equal|less_than|less_than_or_equal, value (or "$otherInput")}] — all must pass; event inputs need only {input}

name: remove_transition
description: Delete the transition at 'index' in state 'from'.

name: add_input
description: Add an input variable: boolean, numeric, string or event (events have no value).

name: update_input
description: Rename an input or change its type/default value. Renames update guards and actions.

name: remove_input
description: Delete an input along with guards and actions that use it.

name: add_interaction
description: Wire a user/playback event (Click, PointerDown/Up/Enter/Exit/Move on an optional layer, OnComplete/OnLoopComplete of a state) to actions.

layer.description: Layer name the pointer interaction is limited to

name: update_interaction
description: Update the interaction at 'index'.

layer.description: Layer name the pointer interaction is limited to

name: remove_interaction
description: Delete the interaction at 'index'.

name: import_svg
description: Import SVG markup as a new editable shape layer (paths, fills, strokes and gradients), centred in the scene unless a position is given.

name: import_lottie
description: Import another Lottie animation (JSON string or object) as a nested scene layer; its assets are merged with remapped ids.

name: import_image
description: Embed a PNG or JPEG (data: URL) as an image asset and add an image layer centred in the scene.

name: apply_motion_preset
description: Animate a layer with a preset (fade_in/out, scale_in/out, pop, slide_in/out_left/right/up/down, spin, bounce, pulse, shake, wiggle, float, blink) starting at start_frame for duration_frames. Values are relative to the layer's current transform; 'intensity' scales distances/angles.

name: stagger_layers
description: Apply the same motion preset to several layers, each starting 'delay_frames' after the previous (in the order given).
